name: executePlan
description: Executes a pre-defined test plan containing multiple steps (click, clearElement, sendKeys, wait, screenshot, tap, swipe, longPress, pressBack, hideKeyboard) in batch mode. By default, MCP tool calls wait for a terminal trace result and can emit notifications/progress updates when the client supplies a progressToken. Set waitForCompletion=false to preserve the legacy asynchronous submit behavior that returns a traceId immediately for later getTrace polling. Use this when you have a complete test sequence ready; for exploratory testing where you need to see results before deciding next steps, use the interactive element operations instead (findElement, clickElement, etc.).

plan.description: Test plan containing an array of sequential steps to execute

selector.description: Element locator using XPath or other strategy (required for click, clearElement, sendKeys, longPress)

params.description: Additional parameters specific to the step type (for example {text: 'hello'} for sendKeys, {ms: 2000} for wait, {x: 100, y: 200} for tap, {startX: 0, startY: 0, endX: 100, endY: 300, durationMs: 250} for swipe)

traceId.description: Optional trace ID for correlating this execution with logs and artifacts. Auto-generated if not provided

waitForCompletion.description: When omitted or true, the MCP tool call waits for terminal completion and returns the final trace snapshot; set false to return immediately with status=running

waitTimeoutMs.description: Optional upper bound for the MCP synchronous wait path in milliseconds; when the timeout elapses the tool returns the latest trace snapshot with waitTimedOut=true instead of failing
